signals.text: These units, taught in a spiralled, recursive curriculum, explore the underlying principles of R HE education at a depth appropriate for the child's age and development stage.

The core of computing is computer science, in which pupils are taught the principles of information and computation, how digital systems work, and how to put this knowledge to use through programming.

pageCache.text:
Reception Year Admissions open 2 November 2026
Welcome
Our Award Winning Infant & Preschool in Alresford
​Set in the heart of New Alresford, Hampshire, we are a warm and welcoming school where children aged 3 to 7 quickly feel safe, settled and ready to learn.
Our ‘Love to Learn’ ethos underpins a calm, caring environment where every child is known as an individual and gently supported to grow in confidence, curiosity and independence from their very first days.
Preschool & Infants are located on the same site as Sun Hill Junior School, we share a close and long-standing relationship that helps make the next step feel familiar and reassuring. We are neighbours of Perins School and together we build strong family connections in Alresford. Through shared values and strong communication, children move on at the end of Year 2 with confidence, ready for the next stage of their journey.
With a rich, engaging school day and a strong sense of belonging, we help our children develop their curiosity and enthusiasm that stay with them long after their time with us.
So. much. fun.
Our happy film
A sincere thank you to SW, our superstar pupils and their families for making this film so special.
Join Our School
A warm and happy start to school life!
Sun Hill Preschool offers a kind, nurturing school where children are gently introduced to learning through play, build early friendships, and grow in confidence. Our teachers know just what a child needs to feel secure and therefore ready to learn about the world.
The perfect start to school
Sun Hill Infant School
Infant School Age 4-7
Children will feel known, happy and proud of what they can do, whether that’s reading their first book on their own, making friends, or finding the confidence to try something new. Our teachers have vast experience of this age group and know just what to do to make your child feel special.
Reception, Year 1 and Year 2
Sun Lane, Alresford, Hampshire, SO24 9NB

pageCache.pageTitle: Curriculum | Sun Hill Infant & Preschool, Alresford
pageCache.text:
Our Curriculum
Our curriculum brings the Sun Hill vision to life through carefully planned and enjoyable learning.
From Preschool to Year 2, children build secure foundations in communication, reading, writing and mathematics, while also developing their knowledge and skills across the wider curriculum. Learning is designed to be active, engaging and meaningful, with opportunities for children to explore, create, ask questions and make connections.
In Preschool and Reception, children learn through a balance of adult-led teaching, play and first-hand experiences. As they move into Key Stage 1 (Year 1 & 2), teaching becomes increasingly structured while continuing to encourage curiosity, independence and creativity.
Our Key Stage 1 classes follow a two-year rolling programme, known as Cycle A and Cycle B. This ensures that children experience a broad and balanced curriculum without repeating the same content.
The pages below explain what children learn at each stage, how knowledge and skills develop over time and the approaches we use to support every child.
Our Vision
Our curriculum is designed to inspire and motivate all of our pupils to be the best learners that they can be. Each child is valued and understood as an individual; academically, socially, emotionally and as a spiritual being.
Our pupils are at the very beginning of their lifelong learning journey and we strongly believe that the curriculum we offer them should enable them to communicate their thoughts and ideas clearly, take risks, develop their collaborative skills, and explore their creativity and to recognise and articulate their strengths.
We never forget that a happy childhood is the right of every child and that play and first-hand exploration of the exciting and diverse world in which we live is a crucial part of the child’s development and key to a happy, successful life.
Gold Standard Early Years Education
The aim of the school is to ensure that the needs of each child are met as far as possible and that each child is empowered to achieve the best of their ability, considering the wishes and feelings of the child and family.
For our Foundation Year children in Year R, we have a set of topics that they move through, with a new theme each half term.
Within Key Stage One (KS1) our curriculum for KS1 operates on a rolling two-year basis. We call these ‘Cycle A’ and ‘Cycle B’ years.
Within each cycle, every term covers a new topic with suitable content and learning goals suitable for all children in the class, whether they are starting their first term in KS1 or approaching the end of their time with us.
This means that all children receive a diverse set of curriculum topics without repeating content in their second year, while ensuring that whatever the age or ability of a child, they’re making progress towards new goals with each fresh term.
You can view what’s covered in each Cycle and Term by viewing our Topic Maps, below. These outline how the theme of each term is taught, and are specific to the age of the children being taught.
Also available to view are our Subject Maps, which outline how a particular subject is taught throughout a child’s time at the school.
At the heart of our curriculum are the visuals arts. As a school that held the Artsmark Gold award for over fifteen years, we understand how the creative arts can both promote and support deep learning in all areas of our curriculum as well as being completely accessible to all pupils regardless of age, gender, ability or disability.

Parents, carers and members of the public who would like further information about our curriculum are welcome to contact the school office.
Religious Education
Religious Education helps children learn about different beliefs, traditions and ways of life. It encourages curiosity, respectful discussion and an understanding of the diverse world in which we live.
Parents and carers have the right to withdraw their child from all or part of Religious Education. Anyone considering this is encouraged to contact the school office so that a conversation can be arranged with the Headteacher.
Supporting Children with SEND
We are committed to ensuring that every child can access, enjoy and participate in the full curriculum. Teachers consider each child’s individual needs and adapt teaching, resources, activities and the learning environment where appropriate.
Children may receive additional support, scaffolding or challenge to help them learn successfully from their individual starting points. We work closely with parents, carers and relevant professionals to identify needs and agree the most appropriate support.
Further information can be found in our SEND Information Report and Accessibility Plan.
Parents and carers who would like to discuss their child’s needs should contact the school office and ask to speak to the school’s Special Educational Needs Coordinator, known as the SENCO.

pageCache.pageTitle: Welcome | Sun Hill Infant & Preschool, Alresford
pageCache.text:
Reception Year Admissions open 2 November 2026
A warm welcome to Sun Hill
​​
​​​​
Our family atmosphere is special and, through genuine care and nurturing relationships, we have created a safe place for our children to feel loved, valued and supported. Every child is known as an individual, and our experienced team works hard to ensure that children feel secure, confident and excited to come to school each day.
We believe that childhood is incredibly precious, and we place great emphasis on allowing children to be children. Our days are filled with friendship, laughter, creativity, stories, songs, exploration and plenty of opportunities to learn through purposeful play and new experiences.
Happy memories stay with our pupils all the way through their education, and we are committed to helping everyone to progress, regardless of their starting point. We have high expectations for every child, while recognising that children develop in different ways and at different times. Our role is to encourage them, celebrate them and give them the confidence to discover just how much they can achieve.
Our school’s motto ‘Love to Learn’ permeates through every aspect of school life, both inside and outside the classroom.
Sun Hill is a place where children can flourish, families feel welcome and learning is approached with enthusiasm and joy. We are incredibly proud of our school and would be delighted to show you what makes it such a special place.
– Mrs Helen Wilson, Headteacher
It is a real pleasure to welcome you to Sun Hill Infant and Preschool, a happy, caring and innovative school at the heart of the Alresford community.
Our Core School Values - REACH
RESPECT | EQUITY | ASPIRE | CREATIVITY | HAPPINESS
Our Ethos & Mission
Our school is a happy and caring place where we value and support the uniqueness of every child, take account of diversity and promote equality and inclusion, to enable all to succeed.
Our ultimate aim is to give all of our children the confidence and enthusiasm to become life-long learners.
Our ultimate aim is to give all of our children the confidence and enthusiasm to become life-long learners.
We strive to generate a warm, caring atmosphere in which all children can participate, flourish and achieve success. Differences between children are recognised and celebrated.
All members of the school community encourage children to work and play alongside each other happily and harmoniously.
We provide exciting and interesting learning experiences, which build upon individual children’s strengths and interests.We also ensure that all children build their understanding of what it takes to be an effective learner and are given daily opportunities to develop their independence.
Headteacher Tours
Our Headteacher has appointments each week to see families wishing to come to Preschool or Infant School. This can be to start immediately, in-year or the following term for Preschool.
Please request to book a visit via our friendly office team and date will be arranged.
adminoffice@sunhill-inf.hants.sch.uk
Open Day
See our School in Action!​
Shortly we will confirm our date for our Autumn Open Morning where you can see the school in full flow.
This is likely to be 2nd week of October, before the School half term. Meet our Headteacher, Preschool Lead and our excellent teachers and staff. We will show you our busy classrooms, our Wildlife Area and Pond, all the many dedicated outside spaces for each year group, the grounds we share with Sun Hill Juniors School.
Sun Hill Infant School - A History
Sun Hill Infant School has been at the heart of Alresford since 1968, welcoming generations of children through its doors and giving them a happy, caring and confident start to their education.
For more than half a century, the school has been an important part of the local community. Teaching methods, classrooms and resources have naturally changed over the years, but the values at the heart of Sun Hill have remained reassuringly familiar: kindness, friendship, curiosity and a genuine love of learning.
In 2018, Sun Hill celebrated its 50th birthday with pupils, staff, families and members of the wider community. The anniversary was a wonderful opportunity to look back at the friendships, achievements and happy memories created at the school, while celebrating everything Sun Hill continues to offer children today.
The introduction of Sun Hill Preschool marked another important chapter in the school’s history, allowing children to become part of the Sun Hill family from the age of three. Preschool children enjoy their own nurturing environment while also benefiting from being part of the wider life of the infant school.
In 2026, we are proud to celebrate 58 years of Sun Hill. We look back with enormous affection at the generations of children, families and staff who have shaped our school, while looking forward with confidence and excitement to the years ahead.
The school may continue to grow and evolve, but the heart of Sun Hill remains unchanged: a happy and caring place where childhood is treasured, memories are made and children develop a lifelong love of learning.

pageCache.pageTitle: Safeguarding | Sun Hill Infant & Preschool, Alresford
pageCache.text:
Safeguarding
Headteacher Mrs Wilson is our Designated Safeguarding Lead (DSL)
Mrs Defelice is our Deputy DSL and also leads on Emotional Health
Miss Riley is also a Deputy DSL
In our school, staff and governors are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of every child within our care.
This page outlines our key policies and documentation in relation to protecting the safety of our children. It also provides information about the teaching and learning of safety within our curriculum.
If you have any worries or concerns regarding any of our children, please ask to speak to Mrs Wilson, Mrs Defelice or Miss Riley.
Alternatively you can email admin@sunhill-inf.hants.sch.uk.
Please note that you can also contact Hampshire Children’s Services on 03005551384 in office hours and 03005551373 out of hours or by email childrens.services@hants.gov.uk.
Our Chair of Governors is Mrs Rosie Waring Green, and the Governor with oversight of safeguarding is Mr Alex Christie. If you wish to contact either of these Governors, please do so through the school office.
Safety is an essential part of the children’s lives at Sun Hill Infant and Preschool. Children work in partnership with teachers to risk assess every day situations and learning experiences.
All classes create class charters at the beginning of the year that include agreed safety rules and whole school safety rules are shared and discussed on a regular basis.
Our PDL and Computing curricula explore personal safety in relation to multiple areas of life: relationships, friendships, use of the internet and Clever Never Goes (previously ‘Stranger Danger’).
For further information on how we embed personal safety within our curriculum, please look at our subject maps.
We use the Safer Recruitment approach from Hampshire County Council to guide our recruitment of staff and volunteers. It helps ensure that, as a school, we:
Understand principles of safer recruitment practice.
Understand why safer recruitment practices are necessary.
Develop a healthy degree of enquiry, rigour and challenge.
Implement safer recruitment practices.
All individuals working at our school have an Enhanced DBS check carried out, and receive annual training on how to keep children and adults safe on our site.
It is key to keeping children safe that they have the language and abilities required to express themselves. That’s why our on-site ELSA input delivers a range of interventions that help support and keep children safe, as well as engaging with parents to provide support to them in developing what’s needed to keep their child healthy, safe and well.
Mrs Defelice works Monday, Wednesday and Thursday mornings.

Reception Year Admissions open 2 November 2026
Welcome
Our Award Winning Infant & Preschool in Alresford
​Set in the heart of New Alresford, Hampshire, we are a warm and welcoming school where children aged 3 to 7 quickly feel safe, settled and ready to learn.
Our ‘Love to Learn’ ethos underpins a calm, caring environment where every child is known as an individual and gently supported to grow in confidence, curiosity and independence from their very first days.
Preschool & Infants are located on the same site as Sun Hill Junior School, we share a close and long-standing relationship that helps make the next step feel familiar and reassuring. We are neighbours of Perins School and together we build strong family connections in Alresford. Through shared values and strong communication, children move on at the end of Year 2 with confidence, ready for the next stage of their journey.
With a rich, engaging school day and a strong sense of belonging, we help our children develop their curiosity and enthusiasm that stay with them long after their time with us.
So. much. fun.
Our happy film
A sincere thank you to SW, our superstar pupils and their families for making this film so special.
Join Our School
A warm and happy start to school life!
Sun Hill Preschool offers a kind, nurturing school where children are gently introduced to learning through play, build early friendships, and grow in confidence. Our teachers know just what a child needs to feel secure and therefore ready to learn about the world.
The perfect start to school

Infant School Age 4-7
Children will feel known, happy and proud of what they can do, whether that’s reading their first book on their own, making friends, or finding the confidence to try something new. Our teachers have vast experience of this age group and know just what to do to make your child feel special.
